813-5289-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
813-5289-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Graaz, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Scholar of the Ages token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-2034-5220-6277-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
1270-2034-5220-6277-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating three creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

2498-8192.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2498-8192.description:
Draw a card.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, causing you to pay 2 life to draw two cards.
Sheoldred triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 3.
2498-8192.notes: You can resolve the extra Sheoldred triggers to gain extra life. When Niv-Mizzet triggers from the lifegain, simply choose not to pay life.

3480-3490-7075-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
3480-3490-7075-7763.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

654-2577-6797-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
654-2577-6797-7084.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the land.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1479-2443-2841-5702.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Evolving Wilds.
1479-2443-2841-5702.description:
Fetch a land using Evolving Wilds.
When the fetched land enters, Springheart Nantuko and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1170-2099-5131-7054--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-2099-5131-7054--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Gravebreaker Lamia.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

1563-2457-6965-7824.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

2583-4636-7810.description:
Activate Whirler Virtuoso by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token and a Food artifact token due to Tippy-Toe.
When the tokens enter, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

624-670-1619-3668.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
624-670-1619-3668.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Flesh Duplicate and Phantasmal Image each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Flesh Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Phantasmal Image trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
624-670-1619-3668.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

6097-7690-7743--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
6097-7690-7743--165.description:
Gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the other Hero.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-1676-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Boss's Chauffeur.
When Boss's Chauffeur dies, its persist ability and second ability trigger.
Resolve the second trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on Boss's Chauffeur.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Boss's Chauffeur from your graveyard to the battlefield. It'll enter with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of creatures you control minus 1 due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1558-3478-3875-4231-5184.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Tireless Provisioner.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Xorn.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-4585-6972.easyPrerequisites: There is another creature on the battlefield.
413-4585-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Custodi Soulbinders.
When Custodi Soulbinders dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Custodi Soulbinders enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

509-1267-4883-5776.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each extra turn
509-1267-4883-5776.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-1267-4883-5776.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Contagion Clasp by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 5.

4365-5086-5183-5231-6824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
4365-5086-5183-5231-6824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4779-6972-7157.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Arcbound Lancer.
When Arcbound Lancer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Lancer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Lancer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

2816-3497-7070.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
2816-3497-7070.description:
Activate Umbral Mantle's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Umbral Mantle ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler.
Repeat.

3593-5231-6990.description:
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Michelangelo from your hand to the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Michelangelo, adding {R}.
When Michelangelo dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1150-2292-6972.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Melira's Keepers
When Melira's Keepers dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

777-3532-5078-6607.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lorescale Coatl triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2292-2842-5220-6900.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

141-313-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-313-6797.description:
Cast Corpse Dance by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Corpse Dance.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Corpse Dance.
Resolve the Corpse Dance copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

38-2173-5220-6578.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.
38-2173-5220-6578.notes: Whether Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel is on the battlefield, the combo will function, either by using Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER's ability or the ability from Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem.

1669-1850-6701.description:
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1669-1850-6701.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

3734-4375-5256.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Phyrexian Metamorph enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Phyrexian Metamorph.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

261-4593-4659-6291.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating a 1/1 Thopter and a 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature token.
When the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter enter, Suture Priest triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and Thopter, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
261-4593-4659-6291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Phyrexian Mite and/or Thopter

uses.n: Plargg, Dean of Chaos // Augusta, Dean of Order

2341-4784.easyPrerequisites:
Augusta is not your commander.
You control a creature that can attack this turn.
2341-4784.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {1}.
2341-4784.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker, triggering Augusta's ability.
Holding priority, activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Augusta's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Augusta's trigger, untapping each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

428-1694-1844-3604.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
You have enough mana to cast Fateful Handoff.
428-1694-1844-3604.description:
Cast Fateful Handoff by paying its mana cost, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Cast Ghyrson Starn by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Ghyrson Starn enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Ghyrson Starn with haste.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn's trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 6.

1126-4871-5117.description:
During your precombat main phase, cast Undying Malice by paying {B}, targeting Xiahou Dun.
Activate Xiahou Dun by sacrificing it, targeting Undying Malice.
When Xiahou Dun dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Xiahou Dun trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Xiahou Dun ability from step 2, returning Undying Malice from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

11-5257-5733.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
11-5257-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue.
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}
Riku's first ability triggers - choose not to pay.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Notorious Throng.
Riku's first ability triggers, causing you to pay {U}{R} to copy Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Notorious Throng, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal created in step 5, copying Notorious Throng and returning the original Notorious Throng to your hand.
Resolve Notorious Throng, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and create a number of 1/1 Faerie Rogue creature tokens.
Repeat each turn.
11-5257-5733.notes: You may pay an additional {U}{R} to copy the extra turn spell, and only need to do this loop during your second extra turn.

643-2907-3510.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand.
643-2907-3510.description:
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, each Scute Swarm you control triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, creating either a 1/1 Insect creature token or a token copy of Scute Swarm.
When the creature token enters the battlefield as a 1/1 Saproling that is also a Forest land due to Life and Limb and Maskwood Nexus, each Scute Swarm you control triggers.
Repeat from step 3.
NOTE: This combo creates an infinite mandatory loop that will draw the game if it is not interacted with.

575-3510-4998.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken Saproling and/or creature with changeling.
575-3510-4998.description:
Activate Savage Thallid's second ability by sacrificing a nontoken Saproling or creature with changeling, targeting itself.
When the creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land and as a 1/1 Saproling due to Life and Limb.
Repeat.

964-1028-2034-4853-4919.notablePrerequisites: You control a mana-producing artifact that can tap to produce at least {U}.
964-1028-2034-4853-4919.description:
Cast Guardians of Koilos by paying {5}.
When Guardians of Koilos enters the battlefield, it and Replication Specialist trigger.
Resolve the Replication Specialist trigger, causing you to pay {1}{U} to create a token copy of Guardians of Koilos.
When the token Guardians of Koilos enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Resolve both Guardians of Koilos triggers, choosing to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Cast Dutiful Replicator by paying {3}.
When Dutiful Replicator enters the battlefield, it and Replication Specialist trigger.
Holding priority, activate a mana-producing artifact by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Resolve the Replication Specialist trigger, causing you to pay {1}{U} to create a token copy of Dutiful Replicator.
When the token Dutiful Replicator enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of the Guardians of Koilos token.
When the Guardians of Koilos token enters the battlefield, it triggers, choose to return nothing to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Dutiful Replicator token and the Guardians of Koilos token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the tokens die, Dross Scorpion triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping the mana-producing artifact.
Activate the artifact by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat steps 14 and 15 one additional time.
Resolve the nontoken Dutiful Replicator trigger from step 7, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Guardians of Koilos.
When the Guardians of Koilos token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the nontoken Dutiful Replicator from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Guardians of Koilos token, adding {C}{C}.
When the token dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the mana-producing artifact.
Repeat from step 6.
Once you have infinite blue and/or colorless mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens.

3976-4377.notablePrerequisites: An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
3976-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Magar by paying {1}{B}{R}, noting Walk the Aeons and putting it face down as a 3/3 creature.
Move to your next turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with the face down creature.
The face down creature triggers, causing you to cast a copy of Walk the Aeons without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 3.

856-4231-5147-5267.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Ulvenwald Mysteries' first ability triggers, creating a Clue, a Food, and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food token, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

962-3263-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Yurlok.
Yurlok does not have summoning sickness.
962-3263-4222.description:
Activate Yurlok by paying {1} and tapping it, causing each player to add {3} to their mana pool.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability twice by paying {2}, untapping Yurlok.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to your next phase, causing each player to lose life equal to the mana in their mana pool.

229-2399-4314.description:
Cast Endless One by paying {0}.
Endless One enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Colfenor and Pawn of Ulamog trigger.
Resolve the Colfenor trigger, returning nothing from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
The Eldrazi Spawn dies, triggering Colfenor, returning Endless One from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2646-3026-4302-5147.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional Angel.
Bloodspore Thrinax has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2646-3026-4302-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Angel.
Bishop of Wings triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
The Spirit enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter and becomes a 4/4 Spirit Angel due to having a +1/+1 counter on it.
Bishop of Wings triggers, causing you to gain four life.
Resolve Goblin Bombardment's ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Spirit token.
Repeat from step 2.

3469-4832-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Energy Arc is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Ensoul Artifact is attached to Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
3469-4832-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
3469-4832-5261.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Energy Arc without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Energy Arc, untapping all creatures you control
Repeat
